text: DAOU Vineyards is owned by Treasury Wine Estates Ltd (ASX: TWE): TWE announced completion of the acquisition of DAOU Vineyards, LLC and its associated entities on 13 December 2023, for an upfront $900m plus an earn-out of up to $100m.
short: DAOU Vineyards is owned by ASX-listed Treasury Wine Estates (acquired December 2023).

source.name: Treasury Wine Estates: ASX announcement 'Treasury Wine Estates successfully completes the acquisition of DAOU Vineyards'
source.quote: Treasury Wine Estates Ltd (ASX:TWE ) (“TWE” or the “Company” ) today announced completion of the acquisition of DAOU Vineyards, LLC and its associated entities (“DAOU”). The acquisition is effective from today.

additionalSources.name: PR Newswire / Treasury Wine Estates: acquisition announcement
additionalSources.quote: Treasury Wine Estates Ltd (ASX:TWE), one of the world's leading wine companies, today announced that it has reached an agreement to acquire DAOU Vineyards
